annotations.title: Create a Reddit product set (which catalog products to advertise)

description: Define a PRODUCT SET in a Reddit catalog — the rule that picks which products a catalog ad group advertises; its id is the productSetId create_reddit_ads_ad_group takes. The filter is Reddit’s JSON rule: one rule {"attribute":{"operator":value}} or several combined with {"and":[…]} / {"or":[…]}. Attributes: id, title, description, price, currency, sale_price, availability, brand, color, gender, product type, item_group_id, condition, age_group, size, pattern, material, custom_label_0…4. Operators: contains, not_contains, i_contains, i_not_contains, starts_with, i_starts_with, is_any, is_not_any, i_is_any, i_is_not_any (the *_any ones take a list), eq, neq, lt, lte, gt, gte — case-sensitive unless prefixed i_. Examples: everything in stock {"availability":{"eq":"IN_STOCK"}}; a brand under 50 {"and":[{"brand":{"eq":"Acme"}},{"price":{"lt":"50"}}]}. Validated before Reddit is asked; spends nothing; read back with how many products match.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

catalogId.description: catalog the product set belongs to

filter.description: the rule as an object (or a JSON string), e.g. {"availability":{"eq":"IN_STOCK"}}
